description: This file defines a builder class for constructing immutable Message objects in a thread-unsafe, fluent API style. It manages message headers, payload, raw payload data, extra JSON data, and response consumers.

classes.name: ImmutableMessageBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with fluent API for creating immutable Message instances, parameterized by the payload type T.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with the specified message headers. Throws NullPointerException if headers are null.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Sets the payload of the message being built.

methods.name: rawPayload
methods.description: Sets the raw payload data as a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Sets additional JSON data associated with the message.

methods.name: responseConsumer
methods.description: Sets a response consumer for the message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable Message instance with the specified components.
